drafts.text: Add the volunteer to the Saturday desk rota only after both the volunteer confirms cover and the hall confirms it will open. If the hall has not replied by Thursday afternoon, mark the entry provisional and ask Jo whether to hold the slot. The caretaker sometimes confirms late, but it is unknown whether that will happen this week. Send arrival instructions only after both the hall opening and the volunteer’s cover are confirmed.

Count returned audio players, check each is in its numbered sleeve, and record the count beside the date in the green ledger. If one is missing, note its number and last-seen time, tell the desk lead before leaving, and do not mark the check complete. If the lead is absent, write “pending lead review” and notify the building manager before locking up; the manager cannot authorise disposal or replacement. Initial the check only when all devices are present and the count is recorded.

Correction: The east gallery humidity alarm event is dated 14 March, not 12 March. The signed condition form records no cause. Duty technician Mara said she noticed the alert at about 16:20; the form does not establish when the sensor first triggered.
Keep the specimen labels dry, and return the tray to the west cabinet.
